rationale: Mouse GeCKOv2 (A+B) knockout screen in MLL-AF9 leukemia cells (Stavast et al. 2022). One library per condition: wild-type MLL-AF9 cells 24 h after selection, and wild-type and Mir139-knockout MLL-AF9 cells 14 days after selection. GSM titles name the samples (mir139WT14d, mir139KO14d, mir139WT24h); prepare.R merges the per-sample files and drops the unassigned-read line. The paper's question is which genes, when knocked out, kill wild-type but not Mir139-KO cells (silencers of MIR139, e.g. Polr2m): guides depleted in WT d14 relative to KO d14. The paper also used WT d14 vs WT 24 h to show MLL-AF9 dependencies (Men1, Eed, Rbbp4, Dot1l, Mllt3); that is the second analysis. With one library per condition run_barcs.R uses the pooled-overdispersion no-replicate path, so calls are screening-level.
